derivedTrace.verification: Reconstructing the original function inside the traced script reproduces the original whole-script hash. Original measurement, retention metadata, HTML and non-script assets are retained and hash-checked. Coordinated derived-header changes still cannot conceal changed code outside the traced function.

derivedReplay.interpretation: No failed local operands captured. This bounded diagnostic pass does not resolve the retained control failure or prove tracing neutral.

followingControlReplay.interpretation: The unchanged control also passed this bounded run. The derived pass therefore does not establish a tracing effect or fix; the earlier exact retained failure remains valid evidence.

derivedRetentionRegression: A failed derived replay retains original measurement, retention metadata and original function bytes; verification succeeds after the synthetic source and derived source directories are removed.
openGates: native qualification while Mac is locked
